subject: POC runway safety net request — Stellardata integration delay
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Blake <tom@stellardata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC runway safety net request — Stellardata integration delay

Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. As discussed, your engineering team hit an unexpected blocker in the connector layer: messages dropped intermittently when the streaming offset grows beyond 48k tokens. Our infra team dug in and we reproduced the behavior in the test harness; I'm attaching the error log that shows the run-to-run delta and stack traces (integration_error_log.csv).

Given the blocker and your timeline to present at the May 12 exec demo, we think the clean path is to give Stellardata a short runway extension plus a small sandbox top-up so your engineers can iterate without being throttled by credits. Specifically we propose:
- 30-day POC extension to the sandbox window (new end date: 2027-05-20)
- $5,000 sandbox credit applied to your account to cover extended runs and stress tests

This is an exception to standard trial policy and I want to get your OK before we route it through approvals. Marissa — looping you in to confirm the ask and surface any compliance/legal requirements. Can you confirm the quantification on expected token usage and whether we need a lightweight addendum/DocuSign for the credit?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we want to keep momentum for the demo.

Best,
Marcus
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: integration_error_log.csv (CSV with timestamps and stack traces)
From: Tom Blake <tom@stellardata.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@stellardata.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC runway safety net request — Stellardata integration delay

Marcus —

Thanks for the fast reproduction and for attaching the log. The trace aligns with what our team saw this morning. We absolutely want to keep the demo timeline, and a short extension + credits would unblock the immediate work. Before we greenlight, two quick asks from our side:
1) Can you quantify estimated extra usage (tokens / compute) so our procurement team can budget?
2) Our legal team needs a simple addendum that covers the credit application and dates — nothing heavy, but something signed.

Looping in Legal Ops; can they confirm the procurement path?

—Tom
VP Product, Stellardata

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Blake <tom@stellardata.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC runway safety net request — Stellardata integration delay

Tom —

Appreciate the call and the clarity. Quantification: based on your current test cadence (3 full runs/day * 30 days with stress tests) we estimate ~1.6M tokens additional consumption — rough calc yields ~$4,800 in incremental usage at current rates, so the $5,000 credit covers the expected delta with a small buffer.

Proposal and next steps (Mutual Action Plan):
- Redwood provides: 30-day POC extension (end date 2027-05-20) + $5,000 sandbox credit applied within 48 hours of signature.
- Stellardata provides: signed credit addendum (DocuSign link below) and confirmation of demo participants by 2027-05-05.
- Technical owners: Rachel (Redwood infra eng) and Priya (Stellardata integration) to triage and validate fixes; weekly sync 30-min cadence until demo.

I attached a short Mutual Action Plan (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) and a draft SOW addendum (SOW-draft-stellardata.pdf). DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/drive?token=abc123

If this looks good, I can route the addendum through our Commercial Ops for a one-click signature. Marcus — I'll need your approval to mark this as a promotional exception in our tracker (DEAL-78934).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, SOW-draft-stellardata.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Blake <tom@stellardata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Legal Ops <legal@stellardata.com>
Date: 2027-04-23T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC runway safety net request — Stellardata integration delay

Tom / Legal Ops —

Thanks, Marissa for drafting the MAP and addendum. From my side I approve the 30-day extension and the $5,000 sandbox credit as an ad-hoc promotional concession tied to DEAL-78934. Please proceed with the DocuSign route; once the signed addendum lands we will apply the credit and update the sandbox expiration.

Kimberly — can you confirm the internal ticket to apply credit and the expected ETA for the credit to appear on their account? Also loop Finance if needed for reconciliation.

Tom — once Legal signs, I'll confirm and flag the account so your team can resume stress testing. We will also schedule the weekly 30-min triage starting Monday 2027-04-26; Marissa will send the invite.

Appreciate the partnership — let's get this stable for your demo.

Best,
Marcus
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
